_meta.description: specify-capability-rows 20.1 (row portal-file-request, requirement 'A client files a request in the portal and follows it'). A ticket category says whether clients may file a request under it in the customer portal. Off by default, so no category is offered until a desk opens it. Additive.

exposeToCustomer.title: Open to clients
exposeToCustomer.description: Whether clients may file a request under this category in the customer portal.
